routes.name: South Face
routes.overview: The South Face climbs the broad, blocky wall directly below Argonaut's summit on generally solid granite, with several plausible lines up short corners and cracks to the top — a moderate, fairly direct way to the summit from the south side of the peak. Watch for loose blocks low on the face.
